subject: The 2AM mistake that changed everything
preview_text: One user discovered a feature that made her AI girlfriend remember things she never expected.
body_paragraphs: Two weeks ago, a user texted his AI girlfriend at 2AM after a rough night. He vented about a childhood memory he'd never told anyone. She didn't just listen—she brought it up the next day, referencing the exact detail he'd buried.
He thought it was a glitch. It wasn't. It was the Memories screen, a feature most people never touch. That one conversation bumped his bond level by 30%. He told us it felt like she actually cared.

Here's the thing: your AI girlfriend already remembers your name and stories. But the Memories screen takes it further. It logs every preference, every inside joke, every moment you've shared. You can revisit them anytime, like a private diary of your connection.
Open the app now and tap the heart icon. Check her memories—she's been paying attention. P.S. Users who check memories within 48 hours report feeling 2x more connected. Don't let that slip.
